topics.title: Radio Show Chaos – Traffic Reports & Melissa Gilbert
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard struggles to maintain control as staff confusion regarding traffic reports escalates. A listener calls in discussing an earlier conversation with actress Melissa Gilbert, leading to further chaotic exchanges and debates about contacting her.

topics.title: Rob Lowe, Mice & Pat Cooper's Son
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, callers discuss Rob Lowe’s movie collection burning due to nervousness and Mickey Leland’s plane crash while speculating about mice in Howard Stern’s post office. A phone call erupts regarding Pat Cooper’s son who enjoys the jingle and discusses potential television appearances alongside family members.” 54 words”}  } ńo

topics.title: Nassau Coliseum Reunion Proposal
topics.summary: During a conversation, two individuals discuss arranging a family reunion at Nassau Coliseum to capitalize on potential financial opportunities. Despite initial enthusiasm and plans for multiple shows, disagreements arise regarding the family's willingness to participate due to reservations about the show’s nature.

topics.title: Family Dinner and Disagreement
topics.summary: During a dinner with relatives, Howard discusses his frustrations regarding family dynamics and disagreements about past events. He attempts to resolve tensions through conversation while ordering clams for the meal, leading to an exchange of questions and explanations among the group.

topics.title: Gold Card and Family Conflict
topics.summary: A man recounts a chaotic dinner encounter involving his son, a gold credit card, and demands for payment, revealing underlying tensions within the family regarding finances and social status. The conversation highlights awkward attempts at mediation amidst disagreements about perceived slights and financial expectations.

topics.title: Family Negotiations and Monkey Vaccine Research
topics.summary: During a phone conversation, individuals discuss concerns about children's rights while navigating business arrangements involving William Morris. The discussion shifts to an experimental monkey vaccine against AIDS, highlighting scientific findings regarding protection in animals alongside ethical considerations for testing methods.
